counterfactual_method.identity_change: Replace the historical object_type fallback with explicit DesignSpecification output declarations carried into contract.outputs.
counterfactual_method.geometry_change: None; historical source and artifacts are not regenerated or rewritten.
counterfactual_method.solid_count_change: None; logical output identity remains distinct from detected solid count.
counterfactual_method.final_verification_rule: Required declared outputs remain hard obligations; a missing generated output remains blocked.
counterfactual_method.package_rule: Existing per-output execution/package path is used once named outputs exist.

cases.basis: The prior audit found useful physical component geometry; explicit output declarations would provide five logical scopes and separate packaging obligations. Historical geometry is not claimed to satisfy each output.
Body/lid identity would be carried into the contract, but the historical concept audit records that the lid was absent. Output declaration restoration cannot synthesize it.
Two valid physical solids were persisted under one logical output. Identity recovery would expose the required scopes; solid-to-output correspondence remains an explicit evidence obligation.

The historical concept contained useful scale geometry despite the one-output contract. Named output declarations would restore the authoritative logical scopes; this is not a claim that the historical source would pass every per-output check.

The historical evidence records useful pump geometry despite fused/collapsed intended parts. Identity routing is recoverable as a structural product-state correction; any remaining geometry mismatch stays a separate engineering result.

The prior audit found recognizable foot/pillar/platform geometry under one output. Named output routing would restore the intended two logical scopes; final per-output geometry remains independently verified.

The historical concept was recognizable but persisted as one output. Identity recovery would remove the upstream collapse; final output/artifact checks remain hard and are not claimed as historically passed.

compatibility.recovery_a_per_output_envelopes: Preserved by source-fact identity plus output scope; unrelated output dimensions cannot be grouped.
compatibility.concept_state: Unchanged; valid partial geometry may remain concept_available while output obligations block final verification.
compatibility.replay_contracts: Unchanged; repeatability contracts remain loaded through the separate replay boundary.
